briefing: Markets are modestly risk-on today with NASDAQ and S&P 500 both up 0.6%. With $889 in idle cash and 3 open slots, we deployed into DOCN, NG, and AMBA — all showing full multi-signal confirmation (MACD crossover, bullish RSI, price above SMA-20, volume surge) rather than letting cash sit idle.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means waiting for multiple technical signals — like a MACD crossover, healthy RSI, price above its moving average, and a volume surge — to line up together before buying, rather than acting on just one signal. This reduces the chance of chasing a false breakout.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指在買入前,等待多個技術指標(例如MACD黃金交叉、健康的RSI水平、股價高於移動平均線,以及成交量放大)同時出現,而非只憑單一訊號進場。這樣可以降低追逐假突破的風險。

market_education.summary_en: Equities drifted modestly higher today, with both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 adding 0.6% in a broad, low-drama advance rather than any single catalyst-driven move. Breadth looked healthy across growth names, with several mid-cap tech and healthcare stocks showing institutional-grade volume surges alongside bullish MACD crossovers. The move looks more like steady accumulation than a news-driven spike, consistent with a calm risk-on tape.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤溫和上揚,納指及標普500指數皆升0.6%,屬於廣泛性、無特定單一消息驅動的穩步上漲。多隻中型科技及醫療股同時出現MACD黃金交叉及成交量放大,顯示機構資金持續流入,市場氣氛偏向穩健的risk-on格局,而非單一新聞刺激下的急漲。
